interface.name: wp_drm_lease_device_v1
interface.description: A DRM lease device advertises non-desktop connectors the compositor can lease. A client may bind this global only to read that list.

request.name: release
request.description: The client will no longer use this object.

event.name: drm_fd

description.summary: open a non-master fd for this DRM node

event.description: The compositor has opened a DRM node for this device.

event.name: connector
event.description: A connector is available for lease.

event.name: done
event.description: All currently available connectors have been sent.

event.name: released
event.description: The compositor is done with this device.

request.name: destroy
request.description: The client will no longer use this connector.

event.name: done
event.description: Static properties of this connector have been sent.

event.name: withdrawn
event.description: The compositor has removed this connector from the lease list.

interface.name: wp_drm_lease_request_v1
interface.description: A batch of connectors to lease.

request.name: request_connector

description.summary: add a connector to the lease

request.description: Indicates that the client would like to lease the given connector.

request.name: destroy
request.description: The client will no longer use this lease.

event.name: finished
event.description: The compositor has revoked the lease.
